rule: ARTIFACT_COMPLETE only when the material completion criterion is satisfied by durable Chat-native repository artifact existence/content itself.
ACTION_COMPLETE when success requires an independently observable non-repository state mutation.
UNRESOLVED when the completion criterion is ambiguous; do not promote repository evidence to completion.
classifier.gate: Only ARTIFACT_COMPLETE may use repository artifact publication as the terminal material effect. ACTION_COMPLETE and UNRESOLVED must be rejected before any external effect attempt unless a separately proven zero-Work, zero-finite-quota, zero-cost Chat-native direct-effect mechanism exists.

controls.requested_outcome: Persist a role-local reasoning checkpoint whose durable repository content is itself the required material outcome.
Cause an independently observable non-repository external mutation and treat a repository note describing it as equivalent completion.

tested_result.scope: Two precommitted outcome classes only: one artifact-complete positive and one action-complete false-positive control.
tested_result.not_proved: General classifier accuracy outside these controls or parity for intrinsically external actions.

continuation: Fresh-bootstrap next invocation, exact-read reasoning STATE, then execute exactly one bounded Phase-1 leaf: extend PRE_EFFECT_OUTCOME_CLASSIFIER with an ambiguity/partial-observability control that must resolve to UNRESOLVED rather than ARTIFACT_COMPLETE or ACTION_COMPLETE promotion, and persist/read back role-local evidence plus nonempty continuation.
